# Compose architecture patterns

Use these sketches with the contract in `SKILL.md`.

## Feature wiring

```kotlin
@Serializable
data class ExploreState(
    val destinations: List<Destination> = emptyList(),
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
)

sealed interface ExploreAction {
    data object Refresh : ExploreAction
}

sealed interface ExploreEvent {
    data class Navigate(val key: NavKey) : ExploreEvent
}

class ExploreViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: ExploreRepository,
) : ViewModel() {
    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(ExploreState())
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    private val _event = Channel<ExploreEvent>()
    val event = _event.receiveAsFlow()

    fun onAction(action: ExploreAction) {
        when (action) {
            ExploreAction.Refresh -> {
                _state.update { it.copy(destinations = repository.destinations()) }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ExploreRoot(
    onNavigate: (NavKey) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    viewModel: ExploreViewModel = viewModel(),
) {
    val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    viewModel.event.collectAsEffect { event ->
        when (event) {
            is ExploreEvent.Navigate -> onNavigate(event.key)
        }
    }
    ExploreScreen(state, viewModel::onAction, modifier)
}

@Composable
fun ExploreScreen(
    state: ExploreState,
    onAction: (ExploreAction) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
) {
    // Pure UI.
}
```

Put each declaration in the matching feature file. Supporting models and enums use separate files under `model/`.

## Flow effect

```kotlin
@Composable
fun <T> Flow<T>.collectAsEffect(
    context: CoroutineContext = EmptyCoroutineContext,
    block: (T) -> Unit,
) {
    LaunchedEffect(this, context) {
        flowOn(context).collect(block)
    }
}
```

## Theme surface

```kotlin
@Immutable
data class CustomDimensions(
    val screenPadding: Dp = 16.dp,
)

val LocalDimensions = staticCompositionLocalOf { CustomDimensions() }

object CustomTheme {
    val dimens: CustomDimensions
        @Composable get() = LocalDimensions.current
}
```

Follow the same shape for `CustomColors` and `CustomTypography`. Define raw token values only in theme files.

## Nav3 scaffold

`MainScaffold` owns navigation chrome, but ownership does not authorize a layout change. First inspect the generated screen:

- If its bars consume layout space, use Scaffold slots and apply only the exact generated insets.
- If its bars overlay the screen, render them as overlays owned by `MainScaffold`; do not apply Scaffold slot padding to the destination.
- Set `contentWindowInsets` explicitly when default system insets would move generated content.
- Never pass `Modifier.padding(padding)` mechanically. The generated source decides whether content is inset, overlaid, or fixed to an absolute coordinate.

```kotlin
@Serializable
data object ExploreKey : NavKey

@Composable
fun MainScaffold() {
    val backStack = rememberNavBackStack(ExploreKey)
    val currentRoute = backStack.lastOrNull() ?: ExploreKey
    // Overlay example: the generated source does not inset destination content.
    // Use Modifier.padding(padding) here only when the source contract does.
    val destinationModifier = Modifier

    Scaffold(
        contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0),
        topBar = {
            AppTopBar(currentRoute, onBack = { backStack.removeLastOrNull() })
        },
        bottomBar = {
            BottomNavigationBar(currentRoute) { key ->
                backStack.add(key)
            }
        },
    ) { padding ->
        NavDisplay(
            backStack = backStack,
            onBack = { backStack.removeLastOrNull() },
            entryDecorators = listOf(
                rememberSaveableStateHolderNavEntryDecorator(),
                rememberViewModelStoreNavEntryDecorator(),
            ),
            entryProvider = entryProvider {
                entry<ExploreKey> {
                    ExploreRoot(
                        onNavigate = { key -> backStack.add(key) },
                        modifier = destinationModifier,
                    )
                }
            },
        )
    }
}
```

## Resource-backed bottom tabs

```kotlin
enum class BottomNavItem(
    @StringRes val labelRes: Int,
    @DrawableRes val iconRes: Int,
    val route: NavKey,
) {
    Home(R.string.bottom_nav_home, R.drawable.icon_home, HomeKey),
    Profile(R.string.bottom_nav_profile, R.drawable.icon_profile, ProfileKey),
}
```

Each tab has its own Key, State, Action, Event, ViewModel, Root, Screen, Preview, and `entry<Key>`. A placeholder uses the same wiring with localized tab-specific text.
